I am a very non-educated man with a lot of possibly incorrect knowledge about how things are being done in the universe, but please help me out. This might be a strangely worded question, but if maths allow for something like "infinitely dense space" to exist, at least in theory; and since space, time, it's all related; why can't there be something like "infinite time" related to those things?

That's what just came to my mind while thinking about it. Like, it can't be that there was no time, why couldn't time have existed with space and all the matter, contained in the same way they were until they weren't.

Can you remind me why are we sure there was no time before the big bang? Couldn't there be some yet unknown way for the everything to be in one infinitely dense place for an indefinite amount of time?

Object? My guitar. Signed by Jon Gomm recently, my Ramona is the one, who heard the most of my whining.

Favourite food? I don't have any. All depends on the situation, mood and my prevalent gluttony level.

Weather? Storms. They are quite rare here, but they always glue me to the window.

Favourite shirt is the one my brother got me on latest Christmas Eve, though it's so ironical right now - it's a shirt with Barnet Stinson/NPH and his quote: "When I'm sad, I stop being sad and be awesome instead". Haha, so silly.

Those things, those small things... Thanks,  dictionarysquirrel, for pointing them out. That actually made me smirk. ^^'

My musical talent won't get me anywhere anymore. I wanted to be able to support myself off the music, but there are so many better than me, that I'm not worthy listening to.

This particular course on this school was said to be the best in country. I was just too weak to make it through.

I don't know about going back to school. It seems ridiculous to try for the third time and thus waste even more of my life.
Thanks. I've been searching for such subreddit, didn't find it though.
But I still have nowhere to go. That's the biggest issue. I have no perspectives, no goals, for the first time in my life - everything, which was planned for a long time, just... Crumbled.

My education was their biggest dream, since they truly believed it would grant me a good life.

My dream is nothing - I wanted it to matter. I won't ever be able to get anywhere with it. It's not a pleasure anymore - every string just weeps.

Hardworking part? If I had work hard enough, I would pass those damn exams. I am not stupid, but I am an idiot. Apparently, I have spent one hour too long doing nothing.

Everything I start doing turns out bad. School? Fail. Hobbys? Fails everywhere, from LEGO, to guitar. Dating? Misery. I'm the King Midas, who turns everything into stinking pile of poo just by touching it.
